title: Adding a category makes a matrix Active and removing it Inactive
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with no category.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on the General Matrix.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Pick category A in the Categories picker.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  7. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  8. Click Edit.
  9. Untick category A in the Categories picker.
  10. Click Save.
  11. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A shows Inactive.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page shows Inactive beside its name.

Step 3:

  • The Categories picker shows in edit.

Step 4:

  • Category A is ticked.

Step 5:

  • Matrix A saves.

Step 6:

  • Matrix A shows Active with category A in its Categories column.

Step 7:

  • Matrix A's title shows its name.
  • Nothing shows beside the name (no Inactive text).

Step 8:

  • The picker shows in edit.

Step 9:

  • Category A is unticked.

Step 10:

  • Matrix A saves.

Step 11:

  • Matrix A shows Inactive again.
  • Its Work Order Matrix value is the same as before.

Whether the category moves when Save is clicked or as soon as the picker closes is asked separately; this test checks the state after Save.
